title: Lysosomal nutrient sensing
summary: Rag GTPases, Ragulator, v-ATPase, GATOR1/2, KICSTOR, FLCN–FNIP and the dedicated amino-acid sensors (Sestrin2, CASTOR1, SAMTOR, SLC38A9, LARS1, SAR1B) that recruit mTORC1 to the lysosome.

title: Growth-factor input (PI3K–AKT–TSC–Rheb)
summary: Receptor tyrosine kinases, IRS-1, PI3K, PTEN, PDK1, AKT, the TSC1–TSC2–TBC1D7 complex, Rheb, PRAS40, and the ERK/RSK, Wnt–GSK3 and IKKβ inputs converging on TSC.

title: Energy, oxygen and stress input (AMPK, REDD1, p53)
title_pl: Wejście energetyczne, tlenowe i stresowe (AMPK, REDD1, p53)
summary: LKB1–AMPK, Raptor Ser792 and TSC2 phosphorylation, hypoxia–REDD1, DNA damage–p53–sestrins, metformin, exercise and caloric restriction.

title: Core complexes (mTORC1 and mTORC2 architecture)
title_pl: Rdzeń: architektura kompleksów mTORC1 i mTORC2
summary: Subunits, domains, TOS/RAIP motif recognition, FRB occlusion, mSin1 autoinhibition and PIP3 relief, distal Akt docking, DEPTOR and PRAS40 brakes.

title: mTORC1 output: translation and ribosome biogenesis
title_pl: Wyjście mTORC1: translacja i biogeneza rybosomów
summary: S6K1, 4E-BP1–eIF4E, LARP1/TOP mRNAs, TIF-IA/UBF (Pol I), MAF1 (Pol III).

title: mTORC1 output: autophagy, metabolism and feedback
title_pl: Wyjście mTORC1: autofagia, metabolizm i sprzężenia zwrotne
summary: ULK1/ATG13/TFEB, the integrated metabolic programme (HIF-1α, SREBP, Lipin1, CAD, ATF4–MTHFD2, c-Myc, PGC-1α) and the S6K1–IRS-1 / Grb10 brakes.

title: mTORC2 regulation and outputs
summary: PIP3–mSin1, ribosome association, S6K1–Rictor feedback; AKT Ser473/Thr450, SGK1, PKC isoforms and their physiological outputs.

title: Circadian coupling
summary: BMAL1 and PER2 restraint of mTORC1; S6K1 phosphorylation of BMAL1; SCN entrainment; rhythmic autophagy.

title: Tissue physiology and disease
summary: Tissue-specific outputs of each complex, gene lesions, mTORopathies, cancer lesion classes, neurodegeneration, immunity and ageing.

title: Pharmacology
summary: Rapalogs, ATP-competitive, dual PI3K/mTOR and bi-steric inhibitors, their targets, selectivity, feedback consequences and adverse effects.
